newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: V&N Waermetechnik to cut 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: V&N Waermetechnik to cut 1996 dividend.

text.p: Austrian heating equipment maker Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik AG said on Friday pre-tax profit in the first nine months slid 19 percent to 77.2 million schillings, adding it would cut its 1996 dividend payment.
Group sales in the first three quarters climbed to 1.37 billion schillings from 1.26 billion in the year-ago period.
For the full year, the company said it expected pre-tax profit to fall to 90 million schillings from 125 million in 1995, with sales rising to 1.8 billion from 1.65 billion.
The company said the board would recommend paying out a lower dividend of 10 schillings, down from 16 in 1995. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
